# N=14 auxiliary iid discrimination — exact 76th affine interval

**2026-10-24. Author-level exact finite-model proof; no Research Driver acceptance or native CLAIM.**

## Theorem and scope
On alphabet {0,1,2} use iid laws P=(1/8,1/24,5/6) and Q=(1/12,1/12,5/6), stopping horizon N=14, all possibly history-dependent randomized tests. Let eP=P(decide Q), eQ=Q(decide P), tP and tQ be expected sample counts and V14(alpha)=inf{max(tP,tQ):eP,eQ<=alpha}. From the author-checked 75th endpoint, alpha75=5171945185876575233/14900301753911083008, V75=24565639510172726849/1862537719238885376 and Q-coin s75=24002357751798781/41779200000000000 at B=(12,0,1), we obtain, **for every real** 0<=delta<=2923025/103474317735493632:

**V14(alpha75+delta)=V75-(120373704/16703)delta.**

Consequently alpha76=5171945186297490833/14900301753911083008, V76=24565639130995559249/1862537719238885376. This Bellman support line ceases to attain the optimum beyond alpha76. The theorem is entirely about the external auxiliary iid model; no BRC/X6/Heartbeat equivalence or physical statement follows.

## Exhaustive rational Bellman lower bound
At state x=(n,a,b) with a zeros and b ones, Q(w)/P(w)=2^(a+b)/3^a independent of order. Set K=lambdaQ=63090576/16703, lambdaP=72+(8/9)K=57283128/16703, Gamma=lambdaP+lambdaQ=120373704/16703. The P-referenced Lagrangian tP+lambdaP eP+lambdaQ eQ has action costs: declare P: lambdaQ 2^(a+b)/3^a; declare Q: lambdaP; continue: 1+sum_i P_i D(next_i) for n<14. Continuation at n=14 is disallowed. Exact Fraction backward induction visits all 680 states and 1240 nonchosen-action comparisons: 1238 strict positive slacks, zero negative, and exactly two ties, A=(10,7,2) continue/P and B=(12,0,1) continue/Q. The minimum positive gap is 2154656646001/68095850840064. At the root D0=575228637796727176547191/228749761209169870848=V75+Gamma alpha75. This proves for every history-dependent randomized feasible test D0<=tP+lambdaP eP+lambdaQ eQ<=max(tP,tQ)+Gamma alpha, hence V14(alpha)>=D0-Gamma alpha.

## Ordered BRC positive-weight history and suffixes
Freeze the 75th tie A75=(4,1,3) to immediate Q, the 74th tie A74=(12,5,1) to immediate P, and retain all earlier deterministic stop decisions (fully specified by verify_n14_76.py). New A=(10,7,2) has 360 nominal ordered prefixes but only 210 survive all earlier stops. Their exact P/Q first-hit masses are pA=175/1207959552 and qA=175/5159780352. All 12 B nominal prefixes survive, pB=48828125/725594112 and qB=48828125/362797056. Conditional continuation suffix risk vector (P-error,Q-error,P-extra-time,Q-extra-time) at A is (635/165888,10201/10368,7711/6912,1069/864); at B it is (63/64,1/144,9/8,13/12). Direct ordered-suffix enumeration gives 21 terminal words in 12 distinct states, with length counts 2 at length 1, 4 at length 3, 15 at length 4. Each of 210 live prefixes visits these 21 completed suffix words under the old rule, hence immediate stopping truncates 4410 completed ordered histories. Path counts are **not** their weighted probability masses. The source audit retains exact rational weights and verifies both total masses equal 1 and both conditional risks equal the recursion.

## Primal certificate for every real parameter
At A stop early with decision P with probability u in [0,1], and at B stop early with decision Q with probability s. A histories have 7 zeros while B histories have zero zeros: no trajectory reaches both sites, so all four risks are exactly affine and their u*s mixed terms vanish (independently checked at all four corners). Set X=pA*R_A.eP=111125/200385994162176, Y=qA*(1-R_A.eQ)=29225/53496602689536, E=pB*(1-R_B.eP)=48828125/46438023168 and H=qB*R_B.eQ=48828125/52242776064. The error changes relative to (u=0,s=s75) are delta_eP=-X*u+E*(s-s75), delta_eQ=Y*u-H*(s-s75). Equalizing them gives s=s75+h76*u with h76=(X+Y)/(E+H)=19297663/34816000000000. The resulting common error increases by eta76*u with eta76=E*h76-X=Y-H*h76=2923025/103474317735493632. The coin stays strictly within [0,1], from s75 to s76=24002380908994381/41779200000000000. At u=0 and u=1, tP-tQ equals 2209467934106972251/3725075438477770752 and 2209467633113056651/3725075438477770752, both positive; affineness gives tP>tQ throughout. All chosen actions are Bellman-minimizing, so tP+lambdaP eP+lambdaQ eQ=D0 and tP=V75-Gamma*eta76*u. Taking u=delta/eta76 attains the dual lower bound for **every real delta** in the interval; seven rational grid samples merely crosscheck the exact formula.

## Right-end sharpness, next frontier and limits
Since both positive dual multipliers force eP=eQ=alpha for equality with the supporting line, and all other Bellman actions have positive slack, even full-history effective tied-state randomness must obey s=s75+h76*u, alpha=alpha75+eta76*u with 0<=u<=1. Therefore the same support line cannot attain equality for alpha>alpha76. Freezing A76 to immediate P yields only the next **candidate** K77=274060260/79973 with A77=(8,2,3), continue versus immediate Q. The 77th interval is unproved. The verifiers are separate author-side exact rational forward and backward checkers **sharing the inherited author stopping table**; this is not independent Research Driver validation. No formal task CLAIM, Result freeze, Lean proof or native X6/Heartbeat bridge is asserted. P000 and ACTIVE worldview remain unchanged.
